nom: StriVectin Advanced Retinol Nightly Multi-Correct Serum

segments.mature: The large majority of reviewers, many in their 40s to 80s, report visibly softer fine lines and wrinkles, firmer texture, and fading brown spots with regular use; one 66-year-old, however, saw no change in lines or pores after 11 weeks of nightly use.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including some also sensitive, report the serum doesn't dry them out further; one reviewer wasn't sure if new dryness she noticed came from the retinol or the summer heat.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some who previously reacted badly to other retinol products with blistering, peeling, or general harshness, report no irritation with this one.

concerns.aging: The large majority of reviewers, many in their 40s to 80s, report visibly softer fine lines and wrinkles, firmer texture, and reduced '11' lines, some noticing a difference within days to two weeks; several others, though, including one who tracked results for 11 weeks, say they saw no change in lines or texture at all.
concerns.redness: Reviewers consistently report no redness or irritation, including several who say other retinol products previously caused problems for them.
concerns.spots: Many reviewers report fading brown spots, sun spots, or scars, including acne scars and one case of scarring from shingles, several noting visible improvement within one to two weeks.
concerns.blemishes: A few reviewers say it also reduced breakouts, including one managing 'middle-aged' breakouts and another using it for a teenage grandson's acne.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers describe the serum as moisturizing, leaving skin feeling hydrated rather than tight; one reviewer noticed increased dryness during use but wasn't sure whether the retinol or the summer heat was the cause.
concerns.oiliness: A couple of reviewers say they wake up slightly greasy after overnight use, though this is described as expected for a night serum; another says it doesn't feel oily at all.

aspects.libelle: Unpleasant scent for a few users
Pump sticks or dispenses too much

extraits.texte: I have been using this nightly since 9/2 on one side of my face. Today is 11/24 and I cannot observe one diminished line or pore in this 66 year old skin. Unles some miracle occurs between now and week 12, i officially question that 100% claim re fine lines. I'll finish the container and, if even an infinitesimal change occurs, i will review again. The 1 star is based on lack of desired result. Other than the complete failure in improving texture and lines, it's an inoffensive cream that doesn't produce irritation. I just wish it had done something for me.

I am 57 years old with a history of dry, sensitive, and sun damaged skin with deep forehead lines. I have used the Strivectin line of products exclusively for over three years. It has taken some time, but I have seen a dramatic improvement in my skin's overall appearance with daily use. I have avoided using any retinol products due to a history of blistering and peeling from another brand several years ago. I purchased this new Strivectin retinol product hoping that it would help to clear multiple large light pink scars on my forehead from a recent bout of shingles that occurred three months ago. All I can say is WOW! I have only been using this product for a week and it is already helping to fade the scars, and it is also dramatically helping with my deep forehead lines. I cannot wait to see what the future results will be with continued use.

I have dry sensitive skin. I also have fine lines and deeper wrinkles. I am 85, my skin looks very good. I use the Advanced Retinol alternately with the Advance Hydration serum. My skin has fewer wrinkles and fine lines. I receive many compliments and inquiries about my skin. Advanced Retinol Cream is easy to apply and is fragrance free. I love this product!
I love this Retinol! Historically, I could never use retinol because it was too harsh on my skin. This product I have been using nightly with no irritation and noticing wonderful differences!

A few positives are no redness or tightness from the retinol. Unfortunately my wrinkles are still the same with zero change since I've started. I love strivectin products and was hopeful with this - maybe with more time it'll get better. My skins texture is also the same.
Have been using for just a few weeks. Loving the results. I'm a 65 year old who thought my good skin days were gone, was I ever wrong. Brown spots are fading and so much softer. Thank you Strivectin.
I Purchased this for my 17-year-old grandson who is having problems with breaking out. He is using it nightly and we can really see the change so I would say my grandson loves it.
